import z3

def minutes_to_time(minutes):
    hours = 9 + (minutes // 60)
    mins = minutes % 60
    return f"{hours:02d}:{mins:02d}"

solver = z3.Solver()

S = z3.Int('S')

# Work hours: 9:00 (0) to 17:00 (480)
solver.add(S >= 0)
solver.add(S + 30 <= 480)

# Frank's constraint: end time <= 9:30 (30 minutes)
solver.add(S + 30 <= 30)

# Emily's busy intervals
busy_emily = [
    (60, 90),   # 10:00-10:30
    (150, 210), # 11:30-12:30
    (300, 360), # 14:00-15:00
    (420, 450)  # 16:00-16:30

    (60, 90),       # 10:00-10:30

    (450, 480)      # 16:30-17:00
